messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Initial dose: 7.5 mg orally two times a day or 5 mg 3 times a day.
The daily dose may be increased in 5 mg increments every 2 to 3 days.
The daily dose may be increased up to 20 to 60 mg/day.
The daily dose is given in divided doses.
Maximum dose: 60 mg per day
Triplet: ["Buspirone", "has maximum dose", "60 mg per day"]

The relation 'has maximum dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not exceed the maximum daily dose specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
D. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
